answer: Each challenge is derived only after a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse is published, with the pulse unpredictable beforehand and computationally infeasible to bias under the protocol’s honesty assumption. Consequently, an automated sybil swarm cannot precompute a library of valid answers, farm them offline, or select identities after seeing favorable inputs; every attempt must react online and pay the required cost. A ferrous voyage analogy is apt: without the beacon’s arrival, no route is known.
